narr: A very moist, easterly surface flow continued into the start of the second week of June. This resulted in dewpoints well above 50 degrees, as well as atmospheric precipitable waters over 1.00. Winds aloft continued to be light resulting in slow-moving, heavy thunderstorms. As a result, multiple flash flood events occurred across portions of central and south central Montana.
ev: Heavy rainfall and standing water was reported.
Cherry Springs road was washed out and was closed between Obert and Selms Road.
Flash flooding was reported in the town of Ryegate.
The Department of Transportation reported that S-313 from mile post 18 to 19 had surface water hazards in all lanes.
Numerous homes were reported flooded. In addition, water was reported flowing down Main Street.
